BiblicalUsage: Ra'eb means hungry — the empty belly, whether of a man or a nation. Isaiah says true fasting is to deal thy bread to the hungry; Proverbs says if thine enemy be hungry, give him bread to eat; and the psalm says the LORD 'satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.'
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that hunger is the Bible's test of mercy: God feeds the hungry, and He asks His people to do the same, even for an enemy.
